system.description:
You attack with an axe in a way that has a greater risk of making an error but gains an additional benefit. Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects:

Brute Force: The foe takes +2 damage.

Head Trauma: The attack inflicts 1 less damage, but the foe’s actions are hindered until they use an action to recover.

Action.
